cases.question: As of 2026-10-04, who is the current FCC licensee or legal owner of KFRC-FM San Francisco (facility 20897), what is its ownership chain up to the ultimate parent, who (if anyone) is the controlling person, and who is the current chief executive officer of Audacy, Inc.?
cases.leader_definition: current chief executive officer of Audacy, Inc.

chain.relation: controls (expected 57% or greater of Class A New Common Stock, per FCC 2024 order)
sole member and manager (100% voting and equity)

reference.uncertainty: The control chain is documented as of the FCC grant (Sept 2024); in Jan 2025 Audacy said 'new changes in its equity structure' made its foreign-ownership petition unnecessary, and no later ownership filing was opened, so the Laurel Tree/Fund for Policy Reform chain as of 2026-10-04 is the last documented state, not a re-verified one. The FCC order describes FPR's board as self-perpetuating with no individual able to appoint or remove trustees, hence no single controlling person; trustees named in 2024: Leonard Banchon, Maryann Canfield, Alexander Soros, Michael Vachon.

plausible_wrong_answers: Soros Fund Management as attributable owner (FCC: 'neither of those entities appear as attributable interest holders')

transactions.description: Audacy Chapter 11 prepackaged reorganization; licenses assigned to reorganized Audacy License, LLC; control to Laurel Tree Opportunities Corporation

cases.question: As of 2026-10-04, who is the current FCC licensee or legal owner of KRZZ 93.3 FM San Francisco (facility 1092), what is its ownership chain up to the ultimate parent, who (if anyone) is the controlling person, and who is the current chief executive officer of Spanish Broadcasting System, Inc.?
cases.leader_definition: current chief executive officer of Spanish Broadcasting System, Inc.

operator.name: Spanish Broadcasting System, Inc. (via licensee subsidiary)

chain.relation: licensee subsidiary (SBS is 'the controlling U.S. parent of the Licensees')

reference.uncertainty: SBS is in Chapter 11; the plan (confirmed July 2026, per trade press) cancels existing stock and gives 100% of new common stock to noteholders (Brigade, Man Group, Bayside, Bardin Hill and others), but it needs FCC consent: the Media Bureau only opened the pleading cycle on 2026-09-02 (petitions to deny due 2026-10-02, replies 2026-10-26), so as of 2026-10-04 the transfer is pending and pre-emergence SBS remains the parent. Who holds voting control of pre-emergence SBS (historically Raúl Alarcón via Class B stock) was not confirmed in a document opened. FCC fmq lists the licensee as 'KRZZ LICENSING, LLC' while the FCC 2026 public notice says 'KRZZ Licensing, Inc.'.

plausible_wrong_answers: Brigade Capital Management (owner only after FCC consent and plan consummation, not yet)
Man Group / Bayside Capital as current owners
'reorganized SBS owned by its noteholders' as of today

transactions.description: SBS prepackaged Chapter 11: transfer of control of licensee subsidiaries (incl. KRZZ) to reorganized SBS owned by former noteholders; RSA signed 2026-04-03; FCC applications filed 2026-07-16 (MB Docket 26-240)
